title: 第2章 税后
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

许存意的脸一下就红了，突然这么戳破，让她有些恼火。

她不懂他说这话的意义。

他淡然的神色，似乎在告诉她，他只是随口一说，别无他意。

她压下被挑起的情绪，把合同递过去，开始走面试流程，做一个简单的自我介绍。

“这里是我所有证件的复印件，你可以看一下。”

许存意做了八年的家政，有用的没用的证件，只要能提高薪资待遇的，她全部都拿下。

因为口碑好，这几年她一直是高端客户的首选。

赵清洵没有打断她，只安静的听着，漆黑的目光落定在她脸上。

许存意连续说了十分钟，说的口干舌燥，嗓音更哑了。她都感觉自己嘴唇都起皮了，偏偏手边没有水。

“哥哥还有什么问题要问吗？”

赵清洵：“你脸很红，没事吧？”

许存意看向他，他的目光里只有关切，倒是挑不出什么问题。

她淡然道：“没事。”

赵清洵唇角微动，说：“夫妻生活和谐是好事，说明他适合你。要是不适合，你又要哭了。”

他这话听起来再正常不过，许存意却从中听出了另一层意思。

以前跟他的每一次，她都会哭。

许存意笑笑，刚要张嘴，赵清洵再次开口，添了句轻飘飘的叮嘱：“但，还是要注意场合。”

许存意用力抿紧唇，看着他一副兄长做派，只想撕碎他的脸。

但他既然要演兄友妹恭的戏码，她自然可以配合。

她露出羞愧的表情，说：“下次一定注意。那么，哥哥对这份合同还有什么问题吗？”

赵清洵轻轻挑眉，没再继续这个话题。

拿过合同，粗略的翻了翻，随口问：“没有住家服务吗？”

许存意：“我没有，如果你愿意相信我，我可以安排另外的人给你。”

“如果是你，多少钱可以呢？”

许存意：“我结婚了，晚上要回家陪老公。而且，我就住在本地，来回很方便。”

赵清洵微微颔首，目光落在纸面上，说：“那一日三餐呢？”

“这个可以，但需要付额外费用。”

“多少。”

“我的话，是八万。”许存意胡乱报价。

Page (1/3)

Xu Cunyi's face immediately turned red. The sudden exposure made her a little annoyed.

She didn't understand what he meant by that.

His indifferent expression seemed to tell her that he just said it casually and had no other intention.

She suppressed her aroused emotions, handed over the contract, and started the interview process, giving a brief self-introduction.

"Here are copies of all my documents. You can take a look."

Xu Cunyi has been working as a housekeeper for eight years. She has obtained all the useful and useless certificates as long as they can improve her salary and benefits.

Because of her good reputation, she has been the first choice of high-end customers in recent years.

Zhao Qingxun did not interrupt her, but listened quietly, his dark eyes fixed on her face.

Xu Cunyi continued talking for ten minutes, his mouth became dry and his voice became hoarse.She felt like her lips were peeling, but there was no water at hand.

"Brother, do you have any more questions to ask?"

Zhao Qingxun: "Your face is very red, are you okay?"

Xu Cunyi looked at him. There was only concern in his eyes, but he couldn't find any problem.

She said calmly: "It's okay."

Zhao Qingxun's lips moved slightly and he said, "It is a good thing that a husband and wife live in harmony, which means that he is suitable for you. If he is not suitable, you will cry again."

His words sounded normal, but Xu Cunyi heard another meaning in them.

Every time she was with him before, she would cry.

Xu Cunyi smiled and was about to open his mouth when Zhao Qingxun spoke again and added a gentle warning: "But you still have to pay attention to the occasion."

Xu Cunyi pressed her lips tightly together, looking at him acting like an elder brother, she just wanted to tear his face apart.

But since he wants to play the role of brother and sister Gong, she can naturally cooperate.

She showed a ashamed expression and said, "Be careful next time. So, does my brother have any questions about this contract?"

Zhao Qingxun raised his eyebrows slightly and did not continue the topic.

He took the contract, flipped through it roughly, and asked casually: "Is there no live-in service?"

Xu Cunyi: "I don't. If you are willing to believe me, I can arrange for another person to be given to you."

"If it were you, how much would it cost?"

Xu Cunyi: "I'm married and I have to go home to be with my husband at night. Moreover, I live locally, so it's very convenient to go back and forth."

Zhao Qingxun nodded slightly, his eyes fell on the paper, and said, "What about three meals a day?"

"This is possible, but you need to pay extra."

"How much."

"In my case, it's 80,000." Xu Cunyi quoted a random price.
